title.zh: Sui Devnet Adds Post-Quantum Signature Support, Targets Mainnet Rollout in Q1 20
title.en: Sui Devnet Adds Post-Quantum Signature Support, Targets Mainnet Rollout in Q1 20

current_state.zh: Mysten Labs added ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signature support to Sui Devnet v1.82.0, processing the network's first quantum-safe transaction via its ExecuteTransaction and VerifySignature APIs, with Testnet expected by end-2026 and native Mainnet account authentication targeted for Q1 2027.
current_state.en: Mysten Labs added ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signature support to Sui Devnet v1.82.0, processing the network's first quantum-safe transaction via its ExecuteTransaction and VerifySignature APIs, with Testnet expected by end-2026 and native Mainnet account authentication targeted for Q1 2027.
